statement: The polynomial $p(x)=x^{3}-3x^{2}-4x+12$. (i) Show that $x=2$ is a root and factorise $p(x)$ completely. (ii) Find the remainder when $p(x)$ is divided by $x^{2}-1$. (iii) Solve $p(x)=0$.
hints: Use the factor theorem at x=2.
Use the remainder theorem with x=1 and x=-1.
